item_name: Rothco 5 Piece Stainless Steel Mess Kit
item_short_desc: The Rothco 5 Piece Stainless Steel Mess Kit is an essential addition to any camper or outdoor enthusiast’s gear. Designed for convenience and durability, this mess kit includes everything you need to prepare meals on the go: a large frying pan with a stay-cool handle, a pan lid, a sauce pan with a hanging handle, a plate, and a plastic cup with a handle. Crafted from durable stainless steel, this kit ensures your food retains its natural flavor while cooking. All 5 pieces conveniently pack into 1 compact unit, making it easy to store.
